note: OriDB's own records as browser tracks. The files are generated from the site release by bin/build_oridb_tracks.py in the oridb-v3 repository, not by a pipeline in this one: they are the database, rendered, and they change when it does. itemRgb carries the tier colour so one track covers every tier, and searchIndex lets a reader type an accession into the browser's position box.

tracks.longLabel: OriDB v3 origin records on sacCer3, coloured by evidence tier; the name links to the OriDB page

OriDB v3 origin elements: A elements in blue and all B elements (B2, B3) in brown, the colours the origin pages use; the class is in the elementClass field and the score is the motif score as a percentage of the matrix maximum
Fragments that were cloned and did not support autonomous replication; a flag on the sites inside them, never a tier
